# Ethics And Human-Subject Gate

Q-PRISM touches neural streams, BCI interfaces, organoids, and human conscious reports. That makes the ethics gate part of the core architecture, not an afterthought.

## Before Human Data

Required:

- written consent,
- purpose limitation,
- data minimization,
- revocation path,
- no hidden external relay,
- clear storage duration,
- review of any medical or psychological risk.

## Before Organoid Work

Required:

- institutional review,
- stimulation limits,
- tissue provenance,
- explicit personhood-status assumptions,
- shutdown and disposal protocol,
- no anthropomorphic claims without evidence.

## Before Neuralink Or Implanted Interface Work

Required:

- clinical authority,
- medical supervision,
- explicit device-safety constraints,
- no experimental pressure on vulnerable subjects,
- clear separation between therapy and research.

## Data Rule

The default test path uses synthetic streams first. Human or biological streams are not needed to validate the simulator/control scaffold.
